long_biography.plain_text:
Heleen Kram developed a private-cruise business after a voyage in Turkey introduced her to small-group travel and the country's wines. A trained wine specialist, she began importing Turkish labels and met Süleyman Tesadif through that trade. He was a member of the crew she had sailed with and wanted to captain his own operation. Together, they launched tailored private journeys around the Greek islands.

Kram manages reservations and trip preparation from the Netherlands, while Tesadif leads the on-water service in Greece. Her work connects guests with local food, wine and cultural stops, including visits to vineyards and restaurants. The business has drawn travellers from Europe, the Americas and the Middle East, combining her interest in hospitality with the captain's seagoing experience.
